drivers.theme: Hawkish Fed hike and higher dot path
Front-end/real yield spike and tighter financial conditions
Persistent inflation and oil/geopolitical supply shocks
Strong growth, earnings and AI capex
Long-end value buying and expected softer inflation prints

parsed.rationale: The Fed delivered a hawkish 25bp hike with dots implying more tightening and a higher neutral rate. Front-end real yields jumped, equities sold off and the curve flattened, signaling tighter financial conditions. Strong growth/AI capex and long-end value buyers cushion, but near-term risk is skewed lower.
